zh-CN.title: 科研接入 Chronelle 日程与会议
items: 完成 Chronelle 完整授权后，可查看本人日程并勾选课题成员合并查看
确认时间段后可发送多人会议邀请，支持结果核对，避免重复创建
日程类别组默认向课题成员隐藏，可由本人开放详情或仅忙闲

en.title: Chronelle calendars and research meetings
items: Bind Chronelle with explicit full authorization to view your calendar and merge selected project members
Confirm a time range to send meeting invitations, with safe delivery checks to prevent duplicates
Calendar groups are hidden from project members by default; choose details or busy-only visibility
